verdict.rationale: The MI325X ships with a large software stack (ROCm, drivers, AMD SMI, GPU Operator), and whether vendor software phones home is a fair privacy question for that stack, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The Device Metrics Exporter and Omnistat are user-side monitoring tools, an adjacent feature that earns no credit, and open-source licensing alone is not an opt-out control.
